section.title: Workspace Protection now available
section.description: Workspace Protection is now available. Including Sophos Protected Browser, DNS Protection, ZTNA and Email Monitoring System, it protects your apps, data and users wherever they're connecting from. Start a trial by going to Free Trials in the My Products menu. Existing ZTNA licences now include all Workspace Protection components.

section.title: Device tagging GA
section.description: We've now added all the planned features to tagging. You can filter devices by tags, either using filters or the search box, and choose which tags show in the tags column. You can tag devices when you're installing Sophos Endpoint, or on your devices list. When you add a tag, we'll suggest tags as you type.

section.title: Partners can reset MFA for customer users or admins
section.description: A Partner Super Admin can now reset multi-factor authentication (MFA) for users and admins in their managed customer tenants.

section.title: Partner: Improved ticketing with Autotask and ConnectWise PSA
section.description: Sophos PSA Tickets are now enriched with Integrated MSP Tool Data.
